chapter.v:
Praise ye
the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.

Blessed be
the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.

From the
rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD’s name is to be praised.

The LORD
is high above all nations, and his glory above the heavens.

Who is
like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,

Who humbleth
himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

He raiseth
up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

That he
may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

He maketh
the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
